scenes.tts: A monkey receives a drop of juice, with no warning. Wolfram Schultz's group recorded single dopamine neurons in the midbrain of behaving monkeys. About three quarters of the recorded neurons, in two monkeys, fired a brief burst. What is that burst telling the brain?
scenes.visual: A neuron trace with a flat baseline; a juice chip arrives with no warning and a green burst rises at the juice; a three-quarters bar and a question mark.
scenes.narration: A monkey receives a drop of juice, with no warning. Wolfram Schultz's group recorded single dopamine neurons in the midbrain of behaving monkeys. About three quarters of the recorded neurons, in two monkeys, fired a brief burst. What is that burst telling the brain?

scenes.tts: Now suppose a sound predicts the juice. After the monkeys learned that the sound predicted the juice, the burst came at the sound rather than at the juice. The response moved from the reward to the cue.
scenes.visual: A sound chip with a predicts arrow to the juice; the burst shrinks at the juice and grows at the sound.
scenes.narration: Now suppose a sound predicts the juice. After the monkeys learned that the sound predicted the juice, the burst came at the sound rather than at the juice. The response moved from the reward to the cue.

scenes.tts: Two more results fill in the picture. When an expected reward was left out, firing dipped below baseline at the time the reward should have come. A reward at an unexpected time evoked a burst. So the firing follows the difference between the reward received and the reward predicted. That is a reward prediction error.
scenes.visual: Omission: a red dip where the juice should be; then juice at an unexpected time: a green burst; then received minus predicted equals reward prediction error.
scenes.narration: Two more results fill in the picture. When an expected reward was left out, firing dipped below baseline at the time the reward should have come. A reward at an unexpected time evoked a burst. So the firing follows the difference between the reward received and the reward predicted. That is a reward prediction error.

scenes.tts: The simplest rule built on this is the Rescorla Wagner rule. Delta is the reward r minus the cue's value V, and the new V is V plus alpha times delta. With alpha at zero point three and a reward of one, V starts at zero. Trial one gives delta of one and V of zero point three. Trial two gives delta of zero point seven and V of zero point five one.
scenes.caption: The simplest rule built on this is the Rescorla-Wagner rule. Delta is the reward r minus the cue's value V, and the new V is V plus alpha times delta. With alpha at 0.30 and a reward of 1, V starts at 0. Trial 1 gives delta of 1.00 and V of 0.30. Trial 2 gives delta of 0.70 and V of 0.51.
scenes.visual: The two equations appear, then bars for trial one and trial two: green delta, teal V.
scenes.narration: The simplest rule built on this is the Rescorla-Wagner rule. Delta is the reward r minus the cue's value V, and the new V is V plus alpha times delta. With alpha at 0.30 and a reward of 1, V starts at 0. Trial 1 gives delta of 1.00 and V of 0.30. Trial 2 gives delta of 0.70 and V of 0.51.

scenes.tts: The error at the reward shrinks as the cue's value grows. After nine trials, V is zero point nine six. In the temporal difference reading, the cue itself arrives unpredicted, so the error at the cue grows toward V. The burst moves from reward to cue, as in the monkeys. These are model units, not spikes per second.

scenes.visual: Nine trials of bars; then two panels, first trial and after nine trials, with the error bar moving from the reward to the cue.
scenes.narration: The error at the reward shrinks as the cue's value grows. After nine trials, V is 0.96. In the temporal-difference reading, the cue itself arrives unpredicted, so the error at the cue grows toward V. The burst moves from reward to cue, as in the monkeys. scenes.tts: Now leave the reward out after long training, with V near zero point nine five. Delta is minus zero point nine five, the dip at the expected time. An unpredicted reward, with V at zero, gives plus one. A recording shows the match, but not that the burst teaches. Keep the rule: in these monkeys, firing follows the reward received minus the reward predicted.
scenes.caption: Now leave the reward out after long training, with V near 0.95. Delta is −0.95, the dip at the expected time. An unpredicted reward, with V at 0, gives +1. A recording shows the match, but not that the burst teaches. Keep the rule: in these monkeys, firing follows the reward received minus the reward predicted.
scenes.visual: A red bar down at minus 0.95 and a green bar up at plus 1; then recording to error is solid, error to teaching is a dashed question; the rule closes it.
